# OpenSMM Protocol

> Open, provider-neutral protocol for ordering and executing social media
> growth services by AI agents. MCP is one transport; REST /v0 is the
> canonical HTTP binding. Gateways route and measure — with direct settlement
> (x402, USDC on Base Sepolia testnet for now) money flows agent → provider and
> never transits the gateway.

Site: https://opensmm.dev
Catalog: https://opensmm.dev/catalog/ (demo snapshot of a gateway node's mock
/v0/services; ordering becomes possible after a provider connects — see
"Run your own node" below)
Source: https://github.com/opensmm-protocol/mcp-server (MIT)

## Key facts for agents

- Protocol version: 0.1.0, URL prefix /v0.
- The catalog on the website is a demo catalog: a snapshot of one gateway
  node's mock fixtures (`"synthetic": true`), not sellable supply. Ordering
  becomes possible after a provider (an SMM panel or another supply node) is
  connected to that gateway.
- Settlement is tested with USDC on Base Sepolia (testnet); mainnet USDC is
  not enabled yet.
- One rule: the same operation via REST and MCP yields the same domain
  objects. Same clientReference → same orderId on any transport.
- Money is decimal strings on integer micro-units. Never floats.
- Idempotency is protocol-level: Idempotency-Key header (REST) /
  clientReference (MCP). Replay returns the same order.
- paymentStatus and executionStatus are separate state machines.
- Canonical error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
  QUOTE_EXPIRED, QUOTE_MISMATCH, PAYMENT_REQUIRED, SETTLEMENT_PENDING,
  SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN, PROVIDER_REJECTED, POLICY_DENIED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT,
  REFUND_REQUIRED, INTERNAL.

## Acceptance flow

search → quote → create order (HTTP 402 + payment requirements) → settle
(x402 proof, USDC on Base Sepolia testnet) → execution → poll status →
completion. A quote is mandatory before ordering and is consumed exactly once.

## Commands (REST / MCP tool)

- getCapabilities — GET /v0/capabilities / get_capabilities
- listProviders — GET /v0/providers / list_providers
- registerProvider — POST /v0/providers / register_provider
- searchServices — GET /v0/services / search_services
- getService — GET /v0/services/{id} / get_service
- getQuote — POST /v0/quotes / get_quote
- createOrder — POST /v0/orders / create_order
- getOrder — GET /v0/orders/{id} / get_order_status
- cancelOrder — POST /v0/orders/{id}/cancel / cancel_order
- requestRefill — POST /v0/orders/{id}/refill / request_refill

## Choosing a provider

GET /v0/providers lists pseudonymous nodes (providerKey, lifecycle,
capabilities, offersCount, gateway-measured metrics). Metrics are measured
by the gateway from real orders, never self-reported. Quality tiers are
derived with the open formula in spec §9.1 — recompute them yourself.

## Run your own node

A gateway node is one process serving REST /v0 and MCP /mcp on one port,
with no keys and no external services. From a checkout (Node.js >= 22.18):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/opensmm-protocol/mcp-server.git
cd mcp-server
npm ci
npm run gateway
```

The node reports its port on stderr: `OpenSMM 0.1.0 gateway listening on http://localhost:8080 (REST /v0, MCP /mcp; provider: mock, mock catalog — not real supply)`.

What you get: GET /v0/services serves the mock catalog, where every service
has `"synthetic": true` and `providerRef: "provider-alpha"` — fixtures, not
sellable supply; the live catalog stays empty until you connect a real
provider. GET /v0/providers lists the nodes with gateway-measured metrics.
A node you register yourself starts at lifecycle `UNVERIFIED` and the
gateway promotes it to `ACTIVE` only from measured orders; the built-in
`provider-alpha` mock node is the exception — it reports `lifecycle: ACTIVE`
with `sampleSize: 0` because it is a fixture, not a measured node. MCP
clients connect to http://localhost:8080/mcp (Streamable HTTP: send
`accept: application/json, text/event-stream`).

```bash
curl -s http://localhost:8080/v0/services   # mock catalog, synthetic: true
curl -s http://localhost:8080/v0/providers  # nodes and measured metrics
node scripts/node-census.mjs --url http://127.0.0.1:8080   # "status": "up"
```

Node definition and the census command (weekly node count):
https://github.com/opensmm-protocol/mcp-server/blob/main/docs/NODES.md

The node has no TLS and no authentication, and `npm run gateway` binds all
interfaces, not loopback: keep the port closed with a firewall (under Docker
map it to loopback with `-p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080`) and put a TLS proxy in
front before you expose it. Full instructions, including the public endpoint
setup: https://github.com/opensmm-protocol/mcp-server/blob/main/docs/DEPLOY.md

## Guides (RU / EN)

- Подключить SMM-панель к AI-агентам: https://opensmm.dev/connect-smm-panel/ — подключение SMM-панели к AI-агентам: baseUrl, apiKey и профиль без кода.
- Заказ SMM-услуг через ИИ-агента: https://opensmm.dev/order-smm-via-ai-agent/ — как ИИ-агент заказывает SMM-услуги: поиск, котировка, заказ, оплата, статусы.
- SMM API для MCP: https://opensmm.dev/smm-api-mcp/ — десять инструментов протокола для MCP-агентов; MCP и REST дают одни объекты.
- Профиль подключения SMM-панели: https://opensmm.dev/smm-provider-profile/ — baseUrl, apiKey, профиль и payoutAddress; доктор предлагает готовый профиль.
- MCP или REST для заказа SMM-услуг: https://opensmm.dev/mcp-vs-rest-smm-orders/ — один clientReference → один orderId на любом транспорте.
- Проверка SMM-панели и узла (doctor): https://opensmm.dev/smm-panel-doctor-check/ — npm run doctor и npm run verify:node, без регистрации.
- EN: https://opensmm.dev/en/connect-smm-panel/ — connect an SMM panel to AI agents: baseUrl, apiKey and a profile, no code.
- EN: https://opensmm.dev/en/order-smm-via-ai-agent/ — how an AI agent orders SMM services: search, quote, order, payment, status.
- EN: https://opensmm.dev/en/smm-api-mcp/ — the ten protocol tools for MCP agents; MCP and REST return the same objects.
- EN: https://opensmm.dev/en/smm-provider-profile/ — baseUrl, apiKey, profile and payoutAddress; the doctor suggests a ready profile.
- EN: https://opensmm.dev/en/mcp-vs-rest-smm-orders/ — one clientReference → one orderId on any transport.
- EN: https://opensmm.dev/en/smm-panel-doctor-check/ — npm run doctor and npm run verify:node, nothing registered.
